name: ChatGPT Atlas → n8n Builder Prompt ⚙️
description_md:
# What You Get

- A copy-paste Atlas Agent Mode meta-prompt that clicks n8n “Build with AI”, drafts nodes, configures settings, injects an LLM system prompt (<800 chars), and saves (not activates) the workflow for review.

- 
Credential safety: never auto-select accounts; if any credential is required or missing, the agent stops and reports the exact item in the Atlas sidebar.

- A prefilled Automation Request example (Gmail → extract name/intent → AI qualify → CRM follow-ups) and quick-start steps (open Atlas on macOS → n8n canvas → “Build with AI” → paste + draft).

- 
Compatibility notes baked in: designed for Atlas Agent Mode (preview) on macOS and n8n’s AI Workflow Builder.Want the companion advanced plays (multi-tool chaining, scoring, QA)?
